excluded_from_unit_coverage.rationale: The Iced view layer, the application loop in lib.rs and the binary edge require a display server and are exercised by the end-to-end target instead of unit tests.

baseline.note: The 90% gate applies to core/ and platform/ pure logic, which now measures 96.49% lines and 92.86% functions (unit_testable_scope.status = at_or_above_target). The overall project percentage (87.71% lines, 84.13% functions) is below the target and is reported as a trend, not a hard CI gate, until feature work begins (design D6): the Iced UI layer, the application loop and the binary edge cannot be unit-tested without a display server.
